name: @sanify/core
description: Sanify Frontend core — fine-grained reactivity, Web Components, store, router, resource, forms. CSR-only, ~10 KB gzip, no virtual DOM
author: Satria Agung Nugraha
_note_exports: Bun resolve: '--target=browser' pakai 'import' → dist/index.js, bukan src/index.ts. Setiap ubah source, jalankan 'bun run build' dulu agar dist tersinkron. '--target=bun' (server/dev) langsung baca src/index.ts via condition 'bun'.
_note_setup_vs_view: Setup function di component() jalan SEKALI — tempat bikin signal/effect/resource. Return value-nya adalah VIEW function yang jalan tiap re-render — hanya di sinilah signal tracking aktif. Jangan baca signal langsung di setup (nilainya cuma kebaca sekali, tidak reaktif).

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --packages external
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run build:types
